certification.name: Microsoft SC-200 Security Operations Analyst Professional Certificate
certification.description: Three Microsoft courses aligned to SC-200 covering threat mitigation with Microsoft Defender, SIEM and SOAR with Microsoft Sentinel, and data protection with Microsoft Purview. Course-based certificate; the proctored SC-200 exam is separate.
certification.currency_note: Program bundle price $216 shown on the edX page (list $240 for the courses bought separately); one-off payment, not a subscription.
